data.additional_information:
Antenna Design Engineer (RF Systems)
Location: Bangalore
Role Type: Full-time / Research Engineer
________________________________________
Role Overview
We are looking for a highly motivated Antenna Design Engineer to work on advanced RF systems involving wideband sensing, direction finding, and communication applications.
This role is ideal for candidates with strong fundamentals in electromagnetics and RF systems, who enjoy translating theory into practical, deployable hardware.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
Antenna Design & Development
• Design and develop wideband and multi-band antennas across sub-GHz to multi-GHz frequencies
• Explore novel antenna architectures for compact and high-performance applications
• Optimize gain, efficiency, bandwidth, and radiation characteristics
• Design for real-world constraints such as size, environment, and integration
________________________________________
Array Design & Spatial Processing
• Develop antenna arrays for direction finding (DF), beamforming, and spatial sensing
• Work on array geometries such as linear, circular, and stacked configurations
• Analyze phase coherence, mutual coupling, and calibration strategies
• Collaborate with signal processing teams for end-to-end system performance
________________________________________
Simulation & Electromagnetic Modeling
• Perform EM simulations using tools such as:
o CST Microwave Studio / HFSS / FEKO / equivalent
• Conduct parametric studies and optimization
• Model effects of ground planes, enclosures, and real-world environments
________________________________________
Measurement & Validation
• Conduct antenna testing including:
o VSWR / S11, radiation pattern, gain, efficiency
• Work with lab equipment such as:
o Vector Network Analyzer (VNA), spectrum analyzer
• Participate in field testing and validation
• Develop calibration and characterization methodologies
________________________________________
Prototyping & Iteration
• Build and test rapid prototypes
• Work with fabrication teams on PCB antennas and RF assemblies
• Iterate designs based on measurement feedback and system needs
________________________________________
Required Skills & Background
• Strong foundation in:
o Electromagnetics and antenna theory
o RF fundamentals and propagation
• Familiarity with antenna simulation tools (CST / HFSS / FEKO or similar)
• Understanding of:
o Impedance matching and RF design basics
o Radiation patterns, polarization, and bandwidth concepts
• Exposure to RF lab measurements or simulations
________________________________________
Preferred (Not Mandatory)
• Experience or coursework in:
o Antenna arrays / beamforming / direction finding
o Wideband or multi-band antenna design
• Familiarity with:
o SDR-based systems or RF signal processing
o Python / MATLAB for analysis and modeling
• Hands-on experience with:
o VNA or RF measurement setups
________________________________________
What We Value
• Strong first-principles thinking
• Ability to move from theory → simulation → prototype
• Curiosity to explore new antenna and RF architectures
• Bias toward practical, field-deployable solutions
________________________________________
Ideal Candidate Profile
• MTech / PhD / final-year students in:
o Electrical Engineering / RF & Microwave / Applied Electromagnetics
• Or candidates with equivalent hands-on experience in RF/antenna systems
________________________________________
What You’ll Work On
• Real-world RF systems involving:
o Wideband sensing
o Spatial signal analysis
o Robust communication links
• End-to-end development from concept to field validation
________________________________________
Outcome Expectations (Initial Phase)
• Develop and validate antenna prototypes
• Contribute to array design and system integration
• Establish measurement and testing workflows
________________________________________
This role offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced electromagnetics, RF systems, and real-world deployment challenges, with significant scope for innovation and impact.
